verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de is a legal-document platform covering notarization, incorporation, translation and filings, so contract-lifecycle tracking is a fair axis for it. The evidence shows no contract repository and no tracking of renewals, expirations or obligations with alerts. Its webhooks cover notarization and appointment events, and the Compliance API mention gives no detail on contract obligations, so these are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, I can track contract renewals, expirations, and obligations with automatic alerts
